newsitem.title: UK: Associated British Ports drops on results.
newsitem.headline: Associated British Ports drops on results.

text.p: Shares in Associated British Ports Holdings Plc retreated on Wednesday as the company's annual profits failed to meet analysts' forecasts, dealers said.
By 0910 GMT, the shares were marked down 8p to 310-1/2p.
ABP said its pre-tax profits rose 5.8 percent to 93.5 million stg in the year ended December 31, 1996. Analysts had forecast pre-tax profits in the range between 95 million and 100.3 million.
"The results weren't desperately disappointing, but (the shares) have had a good run and these numbers don't justify a further run up," said one market maker.
The shares have gained almost 20 percent from December 16, 1996 to Tuesday, when the shares settled at their highest level in more than five months. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
